body:
All three blockers and the extra items are addressed on bug-2169-s1, which has origin/main merged in. Normal push.
(1) seat_tree=clone refuses unless under test or AIDA_DEV_SEAT_CLONE=1. host_git_command returns the refusal process for a seat clone. worktree_dirty_entries reports a clone as dirty without running git. A test shows a planted core.fsmonitor never runs, and the shim lint now covers both builders.
(2) CloneCleanupGuard removes the dir and releases the pin on any later session_start error. A failpoint-before-lease test checks this, and it fails if the guard is removed.
(3) The clone uses --no-hardlinks. A link-count-1 test over the fetched pack fails without the flag.
Also: marker and alternates reads go through symlink_metadata().is_file() and are FIFO-tested. Unverified refuses: find_main_worktree_root and session end error, and main_worktree_root_from returns a /dev/null sentinel.
Beyond the ask: detection no longer trusts the marker alone. A real .git dir plus the aida-seat-* name, or a marker entry of any type, counts as a clone, so a seat that deletes or FIFO-swaps its marker is still refused. create refuses other names.
18 tests pass. check-ci-fast (30 gates) and check-ci-compile pass.
